title: Sita stayed in school because fees were covered.
summary: When Sita's family couldn't afford hostel fees mid-term, a scholarship kept her enrolled. Weekly mentor calls helped her stay focused through exams.
quote: When my hostel fee was covered, I could focus on finals instead of finding work. My mentor's weekly calls kept me on track.
metrics: First in her family to finish secondary school
Now mentors younger students in her ward

image.alt: Students in Nepal working together on laptops

title: Bikash found direction through weekly calls.
summary: Bikash was close to dropping out when a volunteer mentor began weekly check-ins. Career sessions helped him see a path forward in technology.
quote: I didn't know anyone who worked in tech. My mentor showed me it was possible for someone from my village.
metrics: Attended every weekly mentor session for a full year
Now studying computer science at a Kathmandu campus

image.alt: Students learning together in a computer lab

title: Manju's school got its first laptops.
summary: Manju's rural school had no computers until Aashirbad placed laptops with on-site setup. Students now share devices during study periods and weekend labs.
quote: We used to only read about computers in textbooks. Now we can actually use them.
metrics: Weekend coding sessions started for interested students

image.alt: Students sharing laptops in a rural school lab

title: Principal Rai saw attendance improve.
summary: After partnering with Aashirbad, Principal Rai's school saw fewer students dropping out mid-year. Scholarships and devices gave families a reason to keep children enrolled.
quote: Parents used to pull children out for farm work. Now they see the laptops and the mentors, and they want their children to stay.
metrics: Fewer mid-year dropouts since the partnership began
Open classroom days invite nearby schools to visit
